# Kyoto

Four days in Kyoto in early April, during cherry blossom season.

## Fushimi Inari

Walk the trail of vermilion gates up Mount Inari before 7 am, when it is still quiet. The full loop takes about two hours; the fox statues guard the path.

## Arashiyama

Take the train west to the bamboo grove, then cross the Togetsukyo bridge and climb to the monkey park for the view over the city.
